summary: An IAB statement that the public DNS is a hierarchical name space derived from a single, globally unique root. It argues that the DNS cannot technically support more than one public root, which must be served by coordinated root servers under a unique naming authority. It is an informational memo.

eli5.summary: The Internet's phone book starts from one single first page. If there were different first pages, the same name could lead to different places, so there must be only one.

questions: can there be multiple dns roots
